get_config_c2h4: get the FermiNet ConfigDict for the ethene C2H4 molecule with 8 alpha and 8 beta electrons
run_c2h4_calculation: run a FermiNet quantum chemistry calculation on the ethene molecule using the default config
review_c2h4_geometry: review the ethene molecule geometry defined in bohr units with two carbon and four hydrogen atoms
summarize_c2h4_config: summarize the FermiNet configuration for the C2H4 ethene molecule including atom positions and electron count
modify_c2h4_electrons: modify the electron count in the C2H4 config to change alpha and beta electron numbers
